notes: KEY CORRECTION: the MLS 2026 regular season is NOT over. Decision Day is Saturday 2026-11-07 (official MLS schedule), with playoffs Nov 18 to Dec 18, so every active-player MLS line is in progress through Matchday 31 (10-17). No NHL games from 10-20 (WSH-LA, EDM-MIN, BOS-DAL) had indexed results, so NHL lines run through each player's last game on 10-17, 10-18 or 10-19 as noted. Several of our prior through-dates were the check date rather than the game date (McDavid and Pastrnak 10-17, MacKinnon really 10-16 before this update). WebFetch failed (DNS ENOTFOUND), so all values come from search-result text from ESPN, Hockey-Reference, CBS, Rotowire, FotMob, FBref and club sites. Where sources conflict I preferred official league/club or ESPN figures and noted the alternatives. MLS assist counts differ structurally: the MLS official count includes secondary assists, while ESPN and FotMob are lower. Fields that couldn't be verified are omitted. About 55 searches used.
